criteria.rationale: A T3 family may qualify only inside a bounded project-policy contract, with exact value-only spans, resolved actions, independent controls and twins, no critical behavioral debt, and holdout evidence from a frozen product build. Tier and evidence basis never change.

bearer-token.trigger: Case-insensitive Bearer followed by SP or HTAB in Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, or the bounded free-text carrier contexts exercised by the profile.
bearer-token.candidate: The supported bearer alphabet with at most two trailing padding characters and the project-policy length floor.
bearer-token.exactSpan: Credential value only; the Bearer scheme and separator are excluded.
externalFacts: RFC 6750 defines the bearer carrier syntax and b64token alphabet.
projectPolicy: Value-length floors, HTAB acceptance, padding cap, and free-text scope are project choices.

connection-string.trigger: A supported URI scheme, one userinfo separator, a valid host, and a password after colon; Redis and Rediss may use password-only userinfo.
connection-string.candidate: The original undecoded password substring; percent escapes are validated but not decoded.
connection-string.exactSpan: Password substring only, excluding scheme, username, separators, host, port, path, and query.
externalFacts: URI syntax defines authority and userinfo boundaries.
projectPolicy: Supported schemes, Redis password-only handling, size bounds, and exclusion vocabulary are project choices.

otpauth-uri.trigger: A supported otpauth://totp/ or otpauth://hotp/ URI and its first exact secret query parameter.
otpauth-uri.candidate: Uppercase Base32 seed of at least 16 characters with supported trailing padding.
otpauth-uri.exactSpan: Seed plus supported padding only; URI envelope and query key are excluded.
externalFacts: The otpauth URI envelope and Base32 alphabet are externally documented.
projectPolicy: The 16-character floor, case rule, padding rule, and first-parameter behavior are project choices.

generic-token.trigger: Only the supported high-signal or ambiguous field-name vocabulary with =, :, :=, or supported query assignment and a direct literal.
generic-token.candidate: The direct literal after exclusions and the applicable high-confidence or stronger ambiguous-name value contract.
generic-token.exactSpan: Literal value only; field name, operator, quotes, delimiters, and surrounding syntax are excluded.
generic-token.actionResolution: High-signal names redact only when the high-confidence value contract is met and otherwise warn; ambiguous names warn only under their stronger value contract. Block is never claimed.
projectPolicy: Field vocabulary, operators, direct-literal boundary, value contracts, and warn versus redact resolution are project policy.
